name: player_apply_environment_probe_result
description: Player::ApplyEnvironmentProbeResult applies post-probe terrain effects, attachment state, gravity changes, mode transitions, and terrain damage side effects after environment probing.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Player movement/environment class pass so x87 terrain comparisons, attachment matrix source shape, and mode-transition call ordering can be compared with neighboring movement functions.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42d5c0 validates the attachment candidate threshold, cached world-matrix copy from the attachment node, yaw-pose cache adjustment, local offset transform, detach cache restoration, amphib hover-surface transition and splash branch, nominal/water/quicksand gravity selection, underwater entry/exit side effects, lava/quicksand speed scaling, and local-vs-nonlocal damage dispatch.
The native smoke verifies normal terrain reset behavior, quicksand scaling and gravity, attachment activation local-offset caching, and attachment detach yaw/cache restoration.
Existing native smokes cover the delegated environment-probe builder, amphib/hover transitions, nonlocal hit callback, and local destroyed-state damage paths.
